text:
Hi there, and thanks for contacting Leafy! 🌿

Good news: yes, spider plants are on our pet-safe list, so they're a great choice for a home with cats.

A few other plants on our pet-safe list, in case you'd like more options:
- Calathea
- Parlour palm
- Boston fern
- Peperomia

If you're also considering other plants, these are **not** pet-safe, so it's best to keep them away from your cats:
- Monstera
- Pothos
- Peace lily
- Snake plant
- ZZ plant
- Fiddle leaf fig

One important note: if your cat ever eats part of any plant and seems unwell, please contact your vet or a pet poison control service right away. And if it happens with a plant from us, let us know too so we can escalate it to a Support Lead.

If you'd like, I can also share care tips for a new spider plant. Happy planting, and please reach out any time!
